heading: Properties that can be placed in yarn-site.xml
text:
## Properties that can be placed in yarn-site.xml

|  
|  `yarn.scheduler.increment-allocation-vcores`  |  The allocation increment for CPU vcores. No longer preferred. Use `yarn.resource-types.vcores.increment-allocation` instead. Defaults to 1. |

heading: `dfsrouter`
text:
###  `dfsrouter`
Usage: `hdfs dfsrouter`
Runs the DFS router. See [Router](https://hadoop.apache.org/docs/stable/hadoop-project-dist/hadoop-hdfs-rbf/HDFSRouterFederation.html#Router) for more info.

text:
## SSL Configuration[](https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/security.html#ssl-configuration)

To configure the location of the credential provider, set the `hadoop.security.credential.provider.path` config option in the Hadoop configuration used by Spark, like:

```
  <property>
    <name>hadoop.security.credential.provider.path</name>
    <value>jceks://hdfs@nn1.example.com:9001/user/backup/ssl.jceks</value>
  </property>

```

Or via SparkConf “spark.hadoop.hadoop.security.credential.provider.path=jceks://hdfs@nn1.example.com:9001/user/backup/ssl.jceks”.

#### Rounding in cast[](https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/sql-ref-ansi-compliance.html#rounding-in-cast)
While casting of a decimal with a fraction to an interval type with SECOND as the end-unit like INTERVAL HOUR TO SECOND, Spark rounds the fractional part towards “nearest neighbor” unless both neighbors are equidistant, in which case round up.
